WEBSITE INFORMATION

Website terms

Technical information supports an initial assessment. Purchase obligations belong in the agreed contract.

Information and configuration

Product figures come from supplied manufacturer brochures and official pages. They may refer to different versions or configurations. Confirm current specifications, test conditions, standard items, options and custom work in a written quotation.

Suitability and operating conditions

A rated depth, payload or maximum range is not a promise of successful operation in every environment. The site owner, operator and supplier should agree a task-specific plan, safe operating limits and recovery arrangements.

Manufacturer references

Projects described as manufacturer references are attributed to the manufacturer in China. They do not represent projects delivered by this website’s brand or evidence of performance in an untested application.

Commercial commitments

Prices, delivery, acceptance, payment, warranty, training and support are established in the written agreement with the named seller. Preparing a project brief does not place an order or create an accepted quotation.

Names and materials

Manufacturer names, product names and imagery belong to their respective holders. Source attribution does not establish an exclusive distribution arrangement or authorization. Commercial reuse of manufacturer assets and authorized-status wording requires the relevant permissions.
